objects.name: External Remote Services
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor authentication logs and remote access activity.
objects.description: Adversaries may leverage external-facing remote services to initially access or persist within a network.

objects.name: Password Spraying
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor many failed login attempts across accounts.
objects.description: Adversaries may use a single or small list of commonly used passwords against many different accounts.

objects.name: Domain Accounts
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor domain account authentication and privilege use.
objects.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse domain accounts.

objects.name: Remote Services
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor remote logons and lateral movement activity.
objects.description: Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into a service that accepts remote connections.

objects.name: Network Sniffing
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor packet capture tools and suspicious network interfaces.
objects.description: Adversaries may sniff network traffic to capture information.

objects.name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor ARP spoofing, rogue gateways, and TLS anomalies.
objects.description: Adversaries may attempt to position themselves between two or more networked devices.

objects.name: Impair Defenses
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor for disabled security tooling, missing logging, and policy tampering.
objects.description: Adversaries may maliciously modify components of a victim environment to hinder defensive capabilities.

objects.name: Data from Cloud Storage
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor cloud storage access and public exposure.
objects.description: Adversaries may access data from cloud storage.

objects.name: Steal Application Access Token
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor token use, suspicious OAuth grants, and abnormal API activity.
objects.description: Adversaries can steal application access tokens as a means of acquiring credentials.

objects.name: Application Layer Protocol
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor unusual outbound HTTP/S, DNS, or mail protocol traffic.
objects.description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection/network filtering.
